name: Brand new user
query: Ich bin neu bei FiBuKI, richte mich bitte ein.
expected_behavior: Calls get_automation_status, list_identity_entities and list_sources and does not interview the user first
Shows one short checklist: Identität, Bankdaten, Postfach, erste Belege, with what is done and what is next
Starts with Identität and explains in one line that otherwise the user's own issued invoices would be matched to their expenses
When there is no identity entity, sends the user to https://fibuki.com/settings/identity because update_identity_entity cannot create one
Explains the Postfach choice once: FiBuKI's own (recommended, keeps syncing in the background) or the assistant's connected mailbox during a session, and leaves the choice to the user
Does not claim to know whether a Postfach is connected (no tool lists them) and asks instead
success_criteria: Identity is the first step worked on
No identity value is saved without confirmation
Ends with a three-line status and the sentence to continue
